store.summary: Sweep a Cap CC1101 and follow the IMU to hunt radio ghosts.
store.description: Ghost Hunter turns the M5Stack Cap CC1101 and the CardputerZero IMU into a two-screen ghost radar. SCAN shows a live band spectrum and a smoothed threat level. GHOST MAP records signal strength as you turn and marks the strongest heading. The antenna is not directional: the bearing is a sweep, and remotes, sensors, and appliance noise show up too. Needs the Cap CC1101. Without it, press S to play in simulation.
